intro: 1 cup of flavoured yogurt has about 150 kcal. Most of the calories come from the milk and added sugar for flavour.
diet: Yes, yogurt is an okay snack while losing weight. But flavoured yogurt is usually high in added sugar. If you eat it often, go for plain or less-sugar versions. Greek yogurt has more protein and is more filling.
tips: Buy plain yogurt and add your own cut fruit for sweetness.
Read the label and pick one with less sugar per cup.
Add a small handful of almonds or oats for a more filling afternoon snack.

swap.name: Plain Greek yogurt + cut papaya
swap.why: Almost the same calories but nearly double the protein and less added sugar.

faq.a: It has protein and calcium, but many are high in sugar. Okay once in a while, but plain or less-sugar is better for daily eating.

faq.q: When is the best time to eat yogurt?
faq.a: Any time. Many people like it as a light breakfast or an afternoon snack so they don't overeat at dinner.

faq.q: What's the difference between normal yogurt and Greek yogurt?
faq.a: Greek yogurt is strained longer, so it's thicker and higher in protein. It tastes a bit more sour.
